versions.summary: Initial publication. Government-limit standard (Method v2.0) for canned fish, as-consumed. Metal ceilings bound to the general-fish government floor (tHg 500, MeHg 500, Cd 50) after adversarial audit corrected an initial predatory-tuna reading that understated non-predatory canned fish; tin bound to the strictest canned-fishery ML (100000). A species-identified canned product additionally meets its species subcategory where stricter.
